base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN p.XCL_059='F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)*100/COUNT(*)
FROM Patient p JOIN Examination e ON e.XCL_001=p.XCL_058
WHERE substr(p.XCL_060,1,4)='1980' AND e.XCL_008='RA'
